- YTXTube as an extra app (Settings > Extra apps): YouTube and YouTube Music without ads, with SponsorBlock, Shorts, downloads, background play and picture-in-picture, built from YTXTube 2.2.0 (GPL-3.0). Changed for Pulse: AMOLED black by default; the heavy Liquid Glass shaders are replaced by a light translucent look (off by default, a switch in its settings), which is what made the app slow; Shorts is off the bottom bar (a switch brings it back); the mini player has a headphones button (listen only, the sound goes on in the background); songs are saved to Music/YTXTube with their title, artist and cover written into the file, so every music player lists them; the playback settings take the right half of the screen in landscape with the video softly blurred behind; the folder picker is Pulse's own; Google sign-in is in the full build only, not in the Google Play one. YouTube links and shared links open in it.
- Music player: search has a row of icons for what to show (all, songs, albums, artists, lyrics), round shuffle and play buttons, the artists on top in one sideways row of round pictures; an album or artist opens its page (an album no longer starts playing at once) and Back returns to the search with its text. The Blended cover is on by default and lies behind every page (library, search, queue, effects), darker at the foot; the backdrop follows a song started from the search (it kept the old cover) and fills tall screens (a black strip was left at the bottom).
- Screen cover: a frameless AMOLED dashboard (Dashboard > Style: colour, outline or no frame), the pages grouped by kind (clocks, info, media, panels, tools), the charging animations moved under the covers, and the notifications page no longer asks for access that is already given. Charging animation: two full-screen wave looks (Tide, Surge), the Neofetch card centred, and a look from 17 on (Neofetch, Clock, Birds, Poem, Warp ...) is no longer reset to Edge light.
- Neofetch: the real neofetch Android logo, and the lines of the phone start in one column next to it.
- Files: Apps in the storage legend opens the app list; Back from Clean cache returns to the page it was opened from instead of leaving the app.
- Game Hub: Find a game is a slim search bar over the shelf (the shelf moves to the match behind it) instead of a separate page.
- Launcher settings: the category colours follow One UI's palette.
